question: They are involved in the lytic action of cytotoxic T lymphocytes:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Granzimas -> released by cytotoxic T lymphocytes -> induce apoptosis in target cells -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: Cathepsins -> involved in lysosomal degradation -> released by cytotoxic T lymphocytes -> 95%
enhanced_information: Granzimas are involved in the lytic action of cytotoxic T lymphocytes as they are released by these cells and induce apoptosis in target cells. Cathepsins, on the other hand, are involved in lysosomal degradation but their direct role in the lytic action of cytotoxic T lymphocytes is not well-established.
analysis: Granzimas are well-known for their involvement in the lytic action of cytotoxic T lymphocytes by inducing apoptosis in target cells. Cathepsins, although involved in lysosomal degradation, do not have a clearly established direct role in this process. Opsonins, histamines, and integrins are not primarily involved in the lytic action of cytotoxic T lymphocytes.
